summary: Round 7, a catalog-only re-fingerprint. No commit touched projects/tvc_drone after 3d0ef07. Since 1e06c55, catalog/hardware.json gained only screws.M2 washer_d1/d2/h/source and a corrected shoulder_4_m3 buy link. tvc_drone does not depend on shoulder_4_m3. The engine reads washer_h only when a fastener spec sets tab_washers, and tvc_drone sets none, so the change does not alter geometry, fasteners, BOM or checks. kerf check --quick: PASS at e400e7b4a255941c, same 9 part masses, 0 interference, 33 screws aligned, 2 pins coaxial, mass 780.5/790 g, CG 0.4 mm, stand 20.6 deg. The out/ build at 12:42 (FEA all pass) and the round-6 findings stand.

findings.issue: The teardropped servo-tab taps now use the horizontal pilot tap_h = 2.10 mm, which is larger than the M2 major diameter (2.0). The Bambu table's larger horizontal value makes up for the drooping top of a round horizontal hole. A teardrop already removes that droop, so applying both may leave the thread-forming tab screws with little bite. The ring lock taps (M3 PETG tap_h 2.78, for set screws) are fine.
findings.fix: Print a pin/tap coupon (`kerf calibrate`) with a teardropped M2 hole before the full parts. If the screws spin, set a negative tap calibration offset for the printer. Engine follow-up: decide whether tap_h should apply to teardrop holes or only to plain round horizontal ones.

findings.issue: Carried over and accepted: the FEA uses a solid model while the print is 30 % infill with 4 perimeters; lug_fea is 8.10 vs 13 MPa.
findings.fix: Optional: a >= 50 % infill modifier on the three leg lugs.

findings.issue: Carried over: 14 first-layer edges cannot take the 0.5 mm chamfer (deburr warning).
findings.fix: Deburr after printing or use slicer elephant-foot compensation.

findings.issue: Carried over: leg_fea deflection is 2.966 vs 3.0 mm (99 %); accepted.

First recorded here (the warning comes from the ENG-7..20 engine and was already in the 12:42 report): the 20 mm motion.pin_3mm is 1.5 mm / 1.0 mm shorter than the 21.5 / 21.0 mm span. The pin is a press fit in one side (DESIGN.md interface table), so it is retained, but the free-side bore is only partly filled.
findings.fix: Press each pin flush with the outer face of its press side so the whole shortfall sits at the press-side end and the free bearing bore is fully engaged. Optional: lengthen the span to a stocked length or add a note to DESIGN.md.

findings.issue: Carried over and documented in DESIGN.md assembly step 6: a straight 1.5 mm key cannot reach the two upper M2 horn screws.
findings.fix: Use a ball-end 1.5 mm key as the DESIGN says. List it in the tools section of the BOM if it isn't there already.
